scope: One non-load-bearing card/paper geometry gauge derived from the sheet. No wearable load test, electronics, blower, sensors or full five-plate build.

before.observed: The A3 build sheet specifies ENV-D1 dimensions and rail geometry; no physical ENV-D1 gauge is evidenced by this receipt.
before.question: Are the 160 × 110 mm plate, R10 corners, y=30/y=80 rail centerlines and 4 × 30 mm slot geometry sufficiently clear and coherent to fabricate without hidden interpretation?

use: Print one A3 landscape copy for reference. Treat the written dimensions as authority; do not assume the drawing itself is a 1:1 cutting template.
From scrap card/foamboard/paper, make one non-load-bearing 160 × 110 mm rectangle and mark R10 corners.
Mark horizontal rail centerlines at y=30 mm and y=80 mm; verify their 50 mm separation.
Mark the declared 4 × 30 mm rail slots from the sheet geometry without cutting structural material.
Lay two 25 mm-wide paper/webbing strips along the rail lines and check clearance/legibility.
Optionally place a paper/card 160 × 110 × 55 mm cassette-envelope mockup against the gauge. Do not wear it or load it.

after.required_state: One labelled ENV-D1 geometry gauge with measured dimensions plus a PASS / AMBIGUOUS / FAIL decision on whether the sheet is sufficient to fabricate the first real plate.

evidence: Photo of gauge beside the A3 sheet.
Ruler/caliper photo showing 160 × 110 mm outer size.
Photo/measurement showing 50 mm between y=30 and y=80 rail centerlines.
Close-up of one 4 × 30 mm slot marking and R10 corner marking.
Short note listing any dimension that required guessing.
pass_gate: Outer envelope can be laid out without interpretation beyond normal measurement tolerance.
Two rail centerlines measure 50 mm apart.
Slot and corner annotations can be reproduced without conflicting dimensions.
No safety/load inference is made from the card gauge.
residue: Cassette mass/retention and dock transfer untested.
next: If geometry PASS, fabricate one real ENV-D1 plate and add only the two 25 mm rails for a bench-only cassette docking proof. If AMBIGUOUS/FAIL, revise or annotate the single ambiguous geometry before cutting real material.
